% --- Experience: Tavana ---
\newcommand{\cvTavanaName}{Tavana}
\newcommand{\cvTavanaUrl}{https://tavanastore.ir/}
\newcommand{\cvTavanaLocation}{Tehran, Iran}
\newcommand{\cvTavanaTitle}{Frontend Developer}
\newcommand{\cvTavanaDates}{October 2024 -- October 2026}
\newcommand{\cvTavanaBullets}{%
  \item[] \href{\cvTavanaUrl}{\textbf{tavanastore.ir}}: e-commerce site with \textbf{20,000+ daily users}. Next.js App Router, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
  \item Took our Lighthouse performance score \textbf{from 62 to 91} by moving key pages to SSR/SSG, splitting bundles and optimizing images.
  \item Built \textbf{40+ components} for our internal UI library, including form inputs with React Hook Form and Zod. They're documented in Storybook and used in 4 of our products.
  \item Moved server data to React Query and kept client state in Redux Toolkit and Zustand. Redundant API calls dropped by \textbf{about 35\%}.
  \item Set up Sentry with alerts. We fixed production bugs \textbf{about 40\% faster} after that.
  \item Added CI checks (lint, types, build) on every pull request. Each PR also got its own preview deploy for design and QA.%
}
